Defining our Vision. Our vision is a country with:
A re-awakened sense of right and wrong, through the living examples of our
highest leaders;
An organised and widely-shared rapid expansion of our economy through a
government dedicated to honing and mobilizing our people's skills and energies as
welt as the responsible harnessing 01 our natural resources;
A collective belief that doing the right thing does not only make sense morally,
but translates into economic value as well; and
Public institutions rebuilt on the strong solidarity of our society and its
communities.

b. Poverty reduction and empowerment of the poor and vulnerable - to
translate the gains from good governance into direct, imnlediate and

c. Rapid, inclusive, and sustained economic growth - to achieve rapid
economic expansion that generates jobs and livelihood for and increase the
income of the poor while moving away from the boom-and-bust cycle of the
economic performance of the past;
d. Just and lasting peace and the rule of law - to attain a just,
comprehensive, and lasting peace within the bounds of our law; and
e, Integrity of the environment and climate change adaptation and
mitigatton - to promote sustainable natural resource utilization and climate
change adaptation and mitigation strategies and measures among natiot?aI
government agencies, the local government units (LGUs) and their
respective communities, the genera! public, and other stakeholders.
To achieve focus and optimal impact given the available resources of
Government, all departments and agencies shall orient their programs, projects, and
activities towards the purstrit of these five (5) key result areas.
Furthermore, the government shall engage key stakeholders such as the LGUs,
the legislative and judicial branches of government, and the private sector, particularly
the business and civil society, in pursuit of our Social Contract with the Filipino People,

Organizing the Cabinet Clusters. The Cabinet is hereby
organized thematically into five (5) clusters composed of the following: (a) Good
Governance and Anti-Corruption; (b) Human Development and Poverty Reduction: (c)
Economic Development: (d) Security, Justice and Peace; and (e) Climate Change
Adaptation and Mitigation.

Funcfions. The Cabinet Clusters shall serve as the primary
mechanism of the Executive Branch for directing all efforts towards the realizstion of
the Social Contract with the Filipino People and its five (5) key result areas. They shall
set concrete and measurable targets per program andlor project every year until 2016
leading to the intended outcomes as outlined above.
Furttwmore, the Clusters shall assess the degree of accomplishrnenf of their
respective cluster targets in partnership with the private sector and civil' society
organizations; evaluate whether the mi\estones leading to the intended outcomes are
being attained; and undertake the necessary measures to fast-track' prograrn andlor
project implementation. Regular reports on the actual results of program and project
implementation shall be submitted to the Presidential Management Staff.
Final\y, the Clusters shall serve as advisory committees to the Office of the
President. As such, they shall recommend measures on policy and operational
matters for the final consideration of said office.
